ON THE 20 th OF FEBRUARY, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 8007 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 DEEPAK SONI (SONU) S/O RAJENDRA SONI, AGED  ABOUT 30 YEARS, HN 306, PRIMUEM ARKET, BHOPAL  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY MR. RAVI DWIVEDI - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH INCHARGE POLICE  STATION THROUGH POLICE STATION GRP BG ,
 GWALIOR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (MR. ALOK SHARMA - PANEL LAWYER FOR THE RESPONDENT - STATE  AND MR. LALAN MISHRA - ADVOCATE FOR THE COMPLAINANT)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER The applicant has filed this first application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

entities.text: STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH INCHARGE POLICE  STATION
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has been arrested by Police Station G.R.P.B.G., District Gwalior (M.P.) in connection with Crime No. 39/2023 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420 and 201 of IPC.
Allegation against the present applicant - accused is that he changed the ATM card of the complainant and withdrawn some money from his account.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Complainant Perm Chandra Gautam and present applicant have settled their dispute and entered into compromise.
An application in this regard has already been filed before the trial Court.
It is further argued that the applicant is in custody since 25.1.2023.

sentences.text: 1 investigation has already been completed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.
Further argument is that applicant is the permanent resident of Bhopal (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the application citing the criminal history of 17 cases against the applicant and prayed for its rejection.
Learned counsel for the complainant argued that the complainant has no objection if bail is granted to the applicant as the matter has already been settled between the complainant and the applicant.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
